vetSays.line: 🛡️ Brooklyn, the man in his 30s, James and Maya met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Brooklyn, the man in his 30s, Maya are hurt.
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Vy — Craft 1. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Vy chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 1.
🛡️ Vy, Brooklyn, Nadezhda and Eurico met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 driven off. Vy, Brooklyn, Eurico are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Eurico taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Fireside lesson: Eurico passes around European Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
Elder The Loud Beast is BLEEDING — and it likes it. Louder, faster, no more feints.
You STRIKE the Elder The Loud Beast for 91 (Hunting spear).
Elder The Loud Beast's Tail Sweep hits you for 5.
You STRIKE the Elder The Loud Beast for 93 (Hunting spear).
The Elder The Loud Beast falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder The Loud Beast!
📺 You brought down Elder The Loud Beast. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 You brought down Elder The Loud Beast.
🛡️ Vy, Brooklyn and James met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Vy, Brooklyn, James are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🌿 European Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Vy Vazquez, 29 — a welder. Their hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Cold-Blooded, Echo Location, Berserker Rage.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
Cold-blooded: your body budgets like an accountant. (-20% food need today)
Cold-blooded: your body budgets like an accountant. (-20% food need today)
💬 Ingy has been asking Carlos about Cold-Blooded — what it does, what it goes with. Planning something.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Fryderyk just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ María met them at the door — 1 put down. María is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nikos just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🌿 European Elder, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? María just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? María just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ María met them at the door — 1 put down. María is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Lena just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Jimena met them at the door — 1 put down.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
